scene: Living room in the early evening. Mom sits on the sofa at screen-left, leaning back and rubbing her legs slowly; a pair of cozy slippers rests on the floor beside the sofa. Child stands at screen-right. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: A soft, caring mood throughout; Child speaks gently with small helpful gestures; Mom shows one tired smile turning warm; the ending is tender.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Mom sits rubbing her legs slowly; the slippers rest on the floor by the sofa; Child stands facing her with empty hands.
clips.action: Child tilts his head with a caring look and asks his question. Mom pats her legs lightly twice while answering.
clips.end: Mom rests her hands on her knees; Child looks at the slippers by the sofa.

clips.start: Mom rests her hands on her knees; Child looks at the slippers by the sofa.
clips.action: Child points at the sofa seat while offering rest. Mom glances toward the kitchen with a small sigh; Child points off-frame toward the kitchen, then bends down and picks up the slippers with both hands.
clips.end: Child holds the slippers with both hands, turning toward Mom.

clips.start: Child holds the slippers with both hands, turning toward Mom.
clips.action: Child sets the slippers neatly by Mom's feet and looks up at her. Mom reaches out and strokes Child's head once gently; Child stands tall with his hands on his chest, proud to care.
clips.end: Mom's feet rest beside the neatly placed slippers; she smiles warmly; Child stands close by her side.
